title: Python: ssl.get_server_certificate(addr, ca_certs=...) verifies the chain but never the identity (CVE-2026-19552)
description: The Python ssl.get_server_certificate() function, when used with the ca_certs parameter, verifies the certificate chain but does not verify the identity of the certificate. This means that while the certificate's chain of trust is checked, the actual identity of the server certificate is not validated, potentially allowing man-in-the-middle attacks if an attacker can present a valid chain but with a mismatched identity.
